title: Practice: Lead Horizontal Elbow
source: Practice Mode tutorial from the app's Technique Library (practiceData.js › Muay Thai › Lead Horizontal Elbow: cues, mistakes, next). Footage: the owner's clip 8 (ring, 2026-10-31), raw-footage/practice/p8.mp4; three reps facing the camera, the turned-away part left out.

props.description: Horizontal slashing elbow from the lead side

cues.label: STEP IN
cues.say: Coach: "Elbows land at hugging range. Step in, then throw."

cues.text: Strike with the tip of the elbow
cues.label: THE TIP
cues.say: Coach: "The point of the elbow, not the forearm."

cues.label: THROUGH
cues.say: Coach: "Turn the hip and let it travel past the chin."

watch.fix: Short and tight from the guard
watch.label: WIND-UP
watch.say: Coach: "A big wind-up tells them it's coming. It leaves from where your hand already is."
